messages:
Lina (Design): Noticed a usability problem in the Vectors preview: when users expand the relevance inspector the action buttons (Export / Copy) float offscreen on 1366px wide screens. Screenshot in thread. Can we prioritize?
Ethan (Frontend): Repro'd. Table uses min-widths for the Preview cell. Quick fix: make Preview collapse into a toggle chevron and move actions into a sticky right column that overlays when space is tight.
Priya (Product): If we overlay actions, make sure export still supports selecting export format (CSV/NDJSON) and 'include vectors' checkbox. Also product ask: should we warn users about huge downloads?
Marco (ML Eng): Definitely warn. We had a customer hit a 250MB CSV that bloated their pipeline. Suggest we estimate size server-side and show a pre-export size badge. Also NDJSON is safer for long arrays vs CSV escaping.
Lina (Design): Copy suggestion for the checkbox: "Include raw vectors (large files)". For the warning modal: short, helpful tone. Maybe: "This file may be very large (>100MB). Consider NDJSON for downstream processing." Button labels: 'Start export' and 'Cancel'.
Ethan (Frontend): Implementation note: current client export used innerText on a textarea which hits browser limits for very long strings. We'll switch to new approach: stream via Blob and use navigator.msSaveBlob / anchor download. That will prevent truncation.
Nina (Accessibility): A11y nits: 1) sticky action column must be reachable via keyboard (focusable region). 2) Export modal needs role="dialog" + aria-labelledby and focus trap. 3) Relevance delta should have aria-live="polite" on the cell so screen reader users get score updates.
Marco (ML Eng): For the relevance column visual we propose: small delta number with +/- and a micro-sparkline for history. Use color as accent only; include text fallback like "+0.08" or "-1".
Priya (Product): UX question: when users export NDJSON should we add metadata header lines? I think we should add a small manifest file option (include _meta.json) that lists dataset id, row_count, vector_dim, export_time.
Ethan (Frontend): Good idea. We can bundle as a ZIP with manifest + chosen format. That helps customers and avoids parsing ambiguity. Zip creation will be server-side to avoid long client-side zipping.
Lina (Design): Responsive layout follow-ups: 1) add a 'Condensed rows' toggle in the table toolbar (text over icon). 2) collapse the Preview cell into an expandable row so the table stays column-aligned. 3) ensure the sticky actions have a subtle divider and don't occlude content when keyboard focused.
Nina (Accessibility): Add keyboard shortcut to toggle Condensed rows (Ctrl+Shift+C) and expose it in the help overlay. Also ensure reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion for row expand animation.
Marco (ML Eng): On export limits: propose a soft cap for self-serve at 15k rows for full-vector CSV; allow NDJSON for larger but show warning. Enterprise customers can request higher limits. We'll expose an estimated compressed size endpoint to the frontend.
Priya (Product): Decision: default export format = CSV for small exports; if estimated size > 50MB show NDJSON recommended + pre-check 'Use NDJSON' with explanation. Also show an opt-in 'Include raw vectors' checkbox collapsed by default.
Ethan (Frontend): I'll open two PRs: one for layout/toolbar changes, one for the export flow (Blob streaming, server size estimate, ZIP+manifest). I'll include unit tests for long vector serialization.
Lina (Design): I'll attach updated mockups and microcopy for modal and toolbar. Please review focus rings and the CTA hierarchy (primary = Start export).
Nina (Accessibility): I'll run a SR/keyboard pass on the new mocks once PR is up.
ops-bot: Created ticket UI-4982: "Vectors preview responsive actions + safe export flow (NDJSON, size estimate, accessible modal)" and linked mockups and PR placeholders.
